Build knowledge
you can ask.

Arrange selected notes by topic and by overview, topic and detail layers. Ask from this knowledge, then inspect the reference notes refreshed for each question.

Categories group topics; roles describe purpose; hierarchy separates overview from detail; candidate relationships connect sources. These are model judgments to inspect against original notes.

  1. Connect your AI.Use an eligible personal subscription through official Codex or Claude Code, or your own API key.
  2. Build your knowledge.Add your Jev API key for optional ontology-style categories, roles, hierarchy and relationships in selected notes. Basic local retrieval works without Jev.
  3. Ask and inspect.Each question refreshes reference notes, retrieved excerpts and graph highlights. Open the original passages and retrieval details behind the answer.

Local embeddings or keyword retrieval are separate from the answer model. Selected-AI analysis is another build route; advanced Jev analysis is optional.

A conversation beside your work.

Ask about the collection you choose. Notework retrieves relevant Markdown passages locally, then gives your selected answer model the question and eligible evidence.

The right sidebar keeps your current note in view. Read Markdown answers, inspect the reference notes and retrieval details that refresh for each question, and open the original passages when a claim matters.

  • Scope your context with folders, tags and explicit exclusions.
  • Keep model and reasoning choices close to the question.
  • Save conversations and reuse prompts as ordinary vault notes.

Source links help you check an answer. They do not prove that every generated statement is supported.

Find your place in the knowledge.

Small, bright note stars sit in a dark, navigable 3D space. Stable topic colors, hierarchy and role views help you explore a collection without losing the conversation.

Zoom toward the cursor, rotate the graph, and select a star to open its original note. Source highlights connect the current answer with the notes it used.

Graph filters change what you see. Use Pin selected context when you want to narrow future retrieval. Star positions are a navigation layout, not a measured similarity distance.

Keep the thread of a conversation.

After a completed answer, your selected AI automatically organizes exchanges into topics, refinements, branches and follow-ups. The summary dock helps you revisit a question without replacing it with another summary.

Open a card to read its exact original question and answer. Move between the map and the existing chat while your graph and document stay open.

Every completed answer adds one bounded structure request to the same selected answer model: up to 20 eligible pairs within 32 KiB of serialized text. Eligibility verification covers at most 64 distinct source references across that window. The same provider limits or API billing apply. Exchanges outside that verified window remain readable locally. Opening the dock makes no request.

Look past the answer.

The useful next step is often reading the passage behind a claim. Source evidence makes that path short.

Your AI.
Clear boundaries.

The MIT-licensed plugin has no access fee. Accounts, API usage and models have their own terms. Choose answer generation, retrieval embeddings and optional knowledge analysis separately.

A Connected indicator confirms authentication/catalog readiness. It does not guarantee remaining allowance, every model, or successful inference.

Read the connection and data-flow details

Know where your notes go.

Local retrieval gives you a useful boundary, but cloud answers still send data to the connection you choose. Review your scope before using sensitive material.

Cloud questions send selected evidence.

Your question, eligible history, retrieved excerpts and note paths, and explicit text attachments go to the selected provider. Automatic structure sends eligible completed exchanges. Optional AI/Jev builds send selected note excerpts.

Local routes and records stay local.

Ollama requests use the local loopback server. Indexes contain unencrypted excerpts, vectors and source metadata. Optional Markdown conversation archives and prompt notes can sync with your vault.

Desktop connections use installed tools.

Notework discovers official CLIs through PATH/configured paths, checks installation metadata, starts processes, and creates dedicated system-temporary directories outside the vault. It does not install these tools. Restricted execution controls are not an OS sandbox.

Credentials have a defined storage boundary.

API keys and retained direct-login credentials use vault-local Obsidian SecretStorage. It is not an OS keychain or isolation from other plugins. Official Codex and Claude Code retain their own login. Provider retention policies apply independently.

No developer analytics endpoint or automatic diagnostic upload was found in the reviewed implementation. Authentication, model/catalog requests and explicit downloads still use network connections.

Read the full security and data-handling policy

A few useful answers.

Can I use my ChatGPT or Claude subscription?

The desktop connection paths use the separately installed official Codex app-server or unmodified Claude Code CLI, with your own direct login. Your account's eligibility, model access and usage limits apply. API connections are separate and use API billing. Notework does not promise every plan or every model.

Do I need Jev, or a paid cloud embedding API?

Neither is required for local retrieval. Choose local Ollama embeddings or explicit keyword search. Jev is optional analysis for categories, roles, hierarchy and candidate relationships during Build. It uses your own key and provider allowance. The answer model is a separate connection.

Does the conversation map cost extra?

It adds an automatic request after each completed answer under the same selected answer model's limits or API billing. The request is bounded to up to 20 eligible pairs within 32 KiB of serialized UTF-8 text. Eligibility verification covers at most 64 distinct source references across that window. Exchanges outside that verified window remain local. Opening or navigating the summary makes no request.

Can I install it from Community Plugins?

Install from Community Plugins when an approved listing is available. Otherwise use version-matched main.js, manifest.json and styles.css from Releases when available, or prepared assets supplied for authorized prerelease review. A release file does not establish directory approval.

Does it work on my phone?

Mobile is under active development and currently disabled. This release is desktop-only. Disable an older phone copy on the phone itself and keep active/installed community-plugin-list Sync off on both devices. Ordinary note Sync can continue.

Are these screenshots real vault data?

The desktop captures use invented notes and synthetic provider state. The star graph at the top and interactive source examples are authored illustrations. They show the product's working idea and interface, not paid provider results, account access or private vault content.

Where are the website and source?

The website and plugin source use one repository. GitHub Pages serves its docs folder at https://hpsonghyun.github.io/notework-ai/ when hosting is enabled. The older personal-site repository is not a second development target.
